clean_coordinate.information_margins: positive at every held-out depth, +0.233 to +0.501

what_was_measured.noisy_coordinates: all fifteen first pass LATER than the clean coordinate: at 0.30 or at 0.40. None agrees with 0.25; none passes earlier.
what_was_measured.platform_sensitivity: no cell's margin lies within 1e-12 of a sign change; the smallest absolute margin is 1.2e-4. The verdict does not depend on the last-ulp difference between this platform and the one the source matrices were frozen on.

reading_that_does_not_change_the_verdict.the_clean_coordinate_alone: would place the first pass at 0.25, the bracket (0.20, 0.25), which the frozen table classifies SUPPORTING. Stated because it is a fact about the data, and because K9 was frozen precisely so that the clean coordinate could not decide alone. It did not.
reading_that_does_not_change_the_verdict.the_disagreement_is_systematic: every noisy coordinate shifts the crossing in the same direction -- later -- which is what noise that degrades discriminability predicts. It is a displacement, not scatter.
reading_that_does_not_change_the_verdict.a_structural_observation_for_future_roun: K9 requires each noisy coordinate to agree EXACTLY with the clean first-passing grid depth. The clean margin at its first pass is +0.0004; noise at the frozen strengths moves the crossing by one or two grid steps. With an exact-agreement falsifier, a clean crossing whose first-pass margin is small relative to the noise-induced shift makes INVALID the expected outcome. Whether that is the right falsifier is a question a future round may preregister. It cannot be answered from this result, and nothing about this result may be re-read under a different K9.
